belief: Current events tell me exactly when the end is coming.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that current events tell you exactly when the end is coming, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Prophecy teachers who connect news headlines to specific dates. Past predictions that seemed convincing. A desire for certainty in a frightening world. Social media full of end-times speculation. Anxiety that searches for signs.
teaches: Scripture tells us to be watchful, but it is clear that no one knows the day or hour. Jesus said not even the angels know, only the Father. When the disciples asked about timing, Jesus said it is not for them to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed. The Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night. Many confident predictions have come and gone. Our task is not to calculate the date but to be ready and faithful.
self_statements: This event proves the end is next year.
I need to watch the news for every sign.
The experts have calculated the date.
If I miss the signs, I’ll be caught off guard.
I can’t make plans because the end is so close.
errors: Believing you can know what Jesus said no one knows.
Fitting every event into a predicted timeline.
Overlooking the many failed predictions of the past.
questions: What did Jesus say about who knows the day or hour?
What did Jesus tell the disciples when they asked about timing?
How will the Day of the Lord come, according to 1 Thessalonians 5:2?
How many past predictions have failed?
Is watching the news increasing my faithfulness or my anxiety?
What does being ready look like in everyday life?
What would Jesus want me doing today?
truth: Current events do not tell me exactly when the end is coming. No one knows the day or hour except the Father. Jesus calls me to be watchful and ready, not to calculate dates. I can live faithfully today, trust God with the timing, and avoid being swept up by predictions.

hw_truths: No one knows the day or hour but the Father.

log: Each day, write one way I lived faithfully instead of searching for signs.

prayer: Father, thank You that You hold the times and seasons. Help me reject the lie that current events tell me exactly when the end is coming. Keep me watchful and ready, faithful in today’s work, and free from fear and speculation. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
